player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''MadSkills84''') posted a [[Dark]] [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|ISB Operations]] list on DeckTech in December 2001.
description: Deck design by Michael Pistone and Eric Hunter.

shields_note: Posted 'Shields 10' outside the 60; all ten are named. Each dested to its Reflections III Defensive Shield page (the '(Dark)' page where an older Dark Effect has the plain title).
notes: Deck design credited in the post to Michael Pistone and Eric Hunter; the strategy also credits Brad Reinhold and Alan Sagan with the Blizzard 1 / 5D6-RA-7 idea against Lightsaber Combat.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting 7': ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents (posted 'ISB Objective'), Coruscant, Prepared Defenses, Imperial Decree, Mobilization Points, Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans, Fear Is My Ally; these count toward the 60.
Section counts add up to 60, plus 10 Defensive Shields.

Posted 'Coruscant' dested the Dark Special Edition system Coruscant (Dark) (Special Edition); 'Kashyyyk' dested Kashyyyk (Dark); 'SpaceportDB' dested Spaceport Docking Bay (Dark); 'Flagship Bridge' dested Blockade Flagship: Bridge; 'Executor DB' dested Executor: Docking Bay.
Posted 'Epp Maul' dested Darth Maul With Lightsaber (Theed Palace, released 12 December 2001, after this post; the strategy says 'if you don't have him, use a Tatooine Maul').

Posted '2x Tie Cannon' dested Boosted TIE Cannon (TIE starfighter weapon, fits the 2 TIE Interceptors); '4-Lom With Gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Epp Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber; '5D6-RA7' dested 5D6-RA-7 (Fivedesix); 'Commander Merrejek' dested Commander Merrejk; 'Admiral Chiranneu' dested Admiral Chiraneau; 'Mob. Points' dested Mobilization Points; 'IAO & Secret Plans' dested Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans.
The header 'Admirals Order 1' was a section heading, not a card.

A Game Players Network version of this deck (9 December 2001) is already on the wiki as [[MPistone System Overload (Admiral Ozzel Superstar) (ISB)]]; it is a different list (e.g. Darth Maul, Young Apprentice and Executor: Holotheatre).
